scope: Frozen modal-dismissal hook, MemoryFilm, MemoryMovieExport and their actual-component test/harness changes. No source edits, broader refactor, CI invocation, backend/Apple/Expo action or ref change.

sourceReview.committedIdentity: The visit object depends only on bookId and the existing navigation session scope. It is published to the callback ref in useLayoutEffect, so an uncommitted render does not replace the active visit. Film's existing items/index/key/allowed ref is likewise published in a layout effect; immediate stopForDismissal still sets allowed=false synchronously.
sourceReview.sameBookRefresh: New page arrays, renewed media URLs, title/revision and export content-stamp changes do not create a new dismissal visit. The existing close/read intent remains valid for the same committed book and session. A post handoff additionally requires the selected page/post pair to remain in the committed current Film items.
sourceReview.sessionAba: Every dispatch and completion rereads navigationScope. The existing navigationCache module subscribes to auth changes outside screen mounting and increments a revision for session-identity changes. Same-owner replacement and A-to-B-to-A therefore cannot reuse the old scope even if React batches the render.
sourceReview.bookIdentity: A committed book replacement changes the visit object. An old pending action is discarded after native dismissal; a stale control cannot initiate a close of the replacement. The actual production Film caller also keys the component by bookId:viewerId.
sourceReview.singleCompletion: The pending ticket is compared by object identity and cleared before invoking its callback. closing blocks repeated dispatch. Layout cleanup clears pending state and marks the hook unmounted, preventing duplicate, late or unmounted acknowledgements from navigating.
sourceReview.ios: Close/read/post set Modal visible=false while retaining the component until onDismiss. Playback is stopped or export work aborted/released at the request; there is no elapsed-time substitute for acknowledgement.
sourceReview.android: The same cleanup runs, then finish(request) completes immediately because the pinned React Native onDismiss implementation is iOS-only. Duplicate controls or later manually delivered acknowledgement cannot complete twice.
sourceReview.exportWork: Creation and Photos actions first check isDismissing. Abort/result-release ownership remains in the existing dispose/live checks; a late export result is released after cancellation and cannot reopen the dismissed modal.
sourceReview.actualCallerBoundary: MemoryAlbumScreen renders Film only when filmVisible && pages.length > 0, with key bookId:viewerId. A zero-page removal intentionally unmounts the entire Film and invalidates pending work. It must not retain removed/revoked content merely to replay a stale action.
sourceReview.nativeEvidenceLimit: The retained e173 artifact proves the Book settings presentation failure after film/export interactions, not a unique UIKit/Fabric root cause. This review accepts the bounded lifecycle repair; the next native run must demonstrate the actual result.

exploratoryCallerCheck.observation: A direct component harness can keep Film mounted while replacing pages with an empty array, after which its internal item guard removes the Modal.
exploratoryCallerCheck.resolution: Reviewed against the actual production caller and the owner's explicit boundary: that same-mounted empty-page scenario omits the caller's pages.length > 0 condition. Real removal unmounts Film and triggers invalidation. No parent/retention change is requested.
